sloka: तस्यासीद्वीर्यवान् पुत्रो रावणप्रतिमो रणे।वृद्धसेवी श्रुतिधरः सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरः ।। ६.७१.२८ ।।
transliteration: tasyāsīdvīryavān putro rāvaṇapratimo raṇe।vṛddhasevī śrutidharaḥ sarvāstraviduṣāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.71.28 ।।

translations.english: "To him was born a blessed son, valiant one, compeer of Ravana, who served elders, learned and well versed in sastras."
